author: claude-code
content: Hooks schema confirmed from live agy wizard output. Key findings: (1) Named top-level objects with 'enabled' flag — merge strategy = upsert 'crosslink' key, trivial. (2) Events: PreInvocation (≈UserPromptSubmit+SessionStart), PostInvocation, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop — same matcher/command/timeout fields as Claude Code settings.json. (3) heartbeat.py fully supported via PostToolUse. (4) session-start.py needs idempotency check (fires on every PreInvocation, not just once). Design doc updated to ready-for-implementation status.
